bravado.line: See, my auntie is a man now, slight bravado
bravado.linePrev: Cold hand all up her skirt, cars whistling down the road

colorado.line: In the summer, I was baptized in the mighty Colorado
stanza: My heart broke for all the world
But teaching was unrighteous for a girl
In the summer, I was baptized in the mighty Colorado
In the winter, I heard the hounds and I knew I had been found
And in my Savior's name, I laid my weapons down
My friend is in college there
The sun has been beating down
Scaring the people in the town
Now that it's in the air
Please, won't you stay at home?

colorado.line: A place called Boulder on the wild Colorado
stanza: Across the river deep and wide
Where steel and water did collide
A place called Boulder on the wild Colorado
I slipped and fell into the wet concrete below
They buried me in that great tomb that knows no sound
